caption: The drawing depicts a small, wooden stool with a thick, rounded rectangular seat and four slightly splayed legs. The seat and legs are rendered in various shades of brown, showing the grain and texture of the wood. The legs are supported by horizontal wooden stretchers connecting each leg, adding stability. The stool is positioned centrally on a plain, off-white or light beige background with minimal shading or detail, so the focus remains on the stool itself. There is a small, handwritten inscription with a signature and date near the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Pennsylvania Dutch Bed Stool
